Updated for MC 26.3

- Ported to Minecraft 26.3 (Fabric Loader 0.20.1+, Fabric API 0.165.0+26.3, Fabric Language Kotlin 1.14.2, Cloth Config 26.3, Mod Menu 21)
- Requires Java 25
- Switched to Mojang's official names and the non-remapping Fabric Loom (Yarn and Architectury are no longer used)
- Captured worlds now use the 26.x save layout: `dimensions/<namespace>/<dimension>/`, `players/data`, `players/stats`, `players/advancements`, and saved-data files for world gen settings, weather and maps
